name: Lauki Chana Dal
ingredients: ½ cup dry chana dal, soaked
Jeera, hing, turmeric and 1 tsp oil
steps: Pressure-cook with lauki, turmeric and water until tender.
Combine, simmer and finish with coriander and lemon.
note: A useful everyday combination of lentils, vegetables and fibre.
